raw_snippet: Prism builds on the foundation of Crixet, a cloud-based LaTeX platform that OpenAI acquired and has since evolved into Prism as a unified product.
note: OpenAI -> Crixet (cloud LaTeX platform for scientists, relaunched as Prism); sublayer vertical_ai; acquisition; first confirmed in OpenAI's Prism post of 27 Jan 2026; cited from a raw archive capture because the live page refuses scripted requests. Ledger sweep of 23 Sep 2026.
